question: Does Rumble publish a first-party 15 GB standard and 30 GB Premium per-file cap, or only the 1 GB ceiling for video files uploaded to Studio for a livestream?
why: the two per-object-cap limits rows name rumble.support/help as their source, but the first-party help pages read state only the Studio 1 GB limit; the 15 GB and 30 GB figures come from third parties
